prerequisites: Knowledge of material removal forming processes.
Knowledge of tool materials and cutting fluids.
Knowledge of drilling and drill bits.
Knowledge of advanced manufacturing processes: water jet machining, electrical discharge machining and wire EDM.
Knowledge of ferrous materials: properties and applications. Classification according to various criteria and alloy steels.
Knowledge of wear: abrasive wear, adhesive wear and wear mechanisms.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the automation of machine tools through numerical control techniques.
Acquire skills for planning manual programming of numerically controlled machine tools.
Learn the main programming languages for numerically controlled machine tools.
Thoroughly understand the elements incorporated in the computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) environment.
Understand the elements, technologies, equipment, and trends of CAM systems.
Be able to establish and identify the elements of CAM systems in the productive system.
Understand the integration of CAD-CAM-CAE systems.
Learn, at least, how to use a CAM program.
Understand the bases of computer-aided advanced metrology and its industrial application.
Understand the fundamentals of Quality and the implementation of standardized quality systems in productive processes.

syllabus_topics: Tool selection based on dimensional, geometric tolerances, and surface finishes
Document structure. ISO 9000 family of standards
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, it is necessary to obtain at least 35% of the written test grade. Otherwise, the total grade for the subject will be the sum of the grades obtained in all evaluation criteria, up to a maximum of 4.5 points. For students with recognized part-time dedication, non-recoverable activities may be replaced by similar activities with different deadlines or equivalent evaluation tests.
